rs.innovation_approach: 把工具使用拆成可执行轨迹合成、固定图像转变上的接口重标注、以及整轨迹工具质量奖励。先通过GT条件planner和真实执行器造SFT，再对同一视觉操作变换schema，最后用五项外部judge评分辅助GRPO。
rs.key_step: 固定已观察到的前后图像转变，替换工具schema与参数，扩大接口训练覆盖；部署时从新schema推断调用。
rs.why_non_obvious: 工具API写法与视觉操作可以解耦；无需为千种训练接口实现新执行器，但这种离线一致性并不保证生成参数能真实执行。较复杂SFT数据可暂时降低SFT分数，却改善后续RL。
rs.trigger_condition: When executable visual trajectories cover too few interfaces, preserve observed state transitions while varying schema realizations, then refine behavior with feedback-use assessment.
reviewer_praise: low_evidence: manifest无reviews_path，未读到独立审稿。
reviewer_concern: low_evidence: 无review来源；下述疑点为读者核查而非审稿人意见。
rs.acceptance_signal: low_evidence: manifest decision=null；不由upon acceptance措辞推断接收。
rs.abstract_strategy: Separate a reusable operation from its interface and teach multiple interface realizations of the same observed transition.
rs.abstract_key_step: Hold the transition fixed, resynthesize its invocation schema, and combine that supervision with feedback-aware policy refinement.
rs.abstract_why_non_obvious: Valid observations can supervise unfamiliar interfaces without implementing every synthetic interface, but interface validity and executable semantics remain distinct.
rs.abstract_trigger_condition: When surface conventions constrain transfer more than the underlying operation, vary the convention while retaining the observed operation and separately test execution fidelity.

objective.signal_routing: SFT明确assistant turns token CE。RL把五项critic合成一个trajectory reward再加accuracy/format；未提供逐step奖励或segment masks，不能称逐调用credit。全文仅GRPO名称，没有policy loss、优势广播实现、tool/env/prompt/assistant masks、token reduction与clip细节；不从verl默认补完。critic看整轨迹，不是局部before/after反事实。
objective.normalization: 唯一显式归一化是Rtool五项均值，范围0–1、步长.2；每个criterion对raw Rtotal贡献.04。总权重.8+.2+.2=1.2，非归一化凸混合；Rfmt具体实现/范围未详述。GRPO是否mean/std、epsilon、loss按token/sequence平均均未明示；仅G8、KL0可确定。不能把.04当梯度幅度。
objective.invariance: 叫shaping但不是gammaPhi(next)−Phi(state)的PBRS，未证最优策略不变；效率/忠实性judge改变目标偏好。DTC设计保持observations而不保持实际可执行动作语义。若实现使用常见groupmean/std，共同常数被中心化消除、统一正缩放在epsilon可忽略时约去，这是条件推导而非已查实现。
objective.baseline_or_potential: 无显式value model/state potential；Qwen3.5-Plus为外部LLM judge非本文训练的critic网络。GRPO基线公式未给；不能称RLOO或无std。32B tool-relevance用图+题但按能力规则做标签，不测当前策略不调用的反事实；8B difficulty与235B teacher能力也不同。
objective.degenerate_cases: 若五项judge全给1/全给0且全组answer/format相同，标准centered GRPO下无组内信号；若只有toolscore变化，std可能抵消.2缩放。no-tool或无error时feedbackresponsiveness是否N/A未定义；可诱导表面反思/无必要额外调用，未实测。p(direct)≈0无强制支撑恢复；DTC若退化纯改名可能只学解析，若语义不忠实则学伪接口。重复过滤可能删合理再看/恢复轨迹；GTplan可能传递答案线索。
